intent: Compare an engraved mushroom candidate while retaining the original 400x320 layout box, visible stem baseline and separate Caterpillar position.
sourceMasterStorage: Outside Git in generation source storage.
promptRecord: Full generation prompt and prompt hash were not available to this intake. Intent and reference roles are recorded from the generation handoff.

references.role: Engraved print-style reference only; not mushroom geometry

format: WebP quality 92, method 6, with lossless alpha
transforms: Encoding only, without crop, resize, paint, cleanup or raster transform. The original 1402x1122 canvas and alpha bytes are retained. RGB uses lossy WebP compression.

placement.scope: Only the mushroom image inside the existing .ct__mushroom > .art; no Caterpillar wrapper changes.

limitations: Explicit artPreview=mushroom comparison only; not selected by the default art registry.
Cap support is approximately 16-19 logical pixels higher than the original under the Caterpillar feet; overlap needs visual review.
Stem-ground alignment is measured; cap support, margins, fine linework and alpha edges are not visually accepted in the running scene.
Source generation is a new illustration using references, not a pixel-preserving edit.
Original baked or vector mushroom remains until the candidate loads, on load error and whenever its checkbox is unchecked.
No browser visual QA pass is claimed; the existing local Chromium launch restriction remains.
rights: Project-owned generated candidate; no licence grant. No third-party artwork copied into runtime.
